## History

Jonas previously tried to pursue a different vocation before answering a call to the ministry. After graduating from [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and studying theology as a student from St. [Columbia](../codex/places.md#columbia), he took charge of the [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) Mission Church for the summer. During that summer, he served as an earnest theological student preaching at the church, catching the growing affection of fellow boarder [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_

## Relationships

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--phil-gordon.md)

[Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) and Jonas developed a close relationship after spending time together fishing, boating, and walking. During a summer stay at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) where Jonas was preaching as a theological student, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) grew fond of him despite her initial internal conflicts. Their bond eventually deepened to the point of becoming engaged and subsequently married.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), +9 more_
